import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data/FUN_company_pl_actuals_dataset.csv')

# Filter for Net Revenue in 2024
revenue_2024 = df[(df['Fiscal Year'] == 2024) & (df['FSLine Statement L1'] == 'Net Revenue')]

# Calculate total revenue
total_revenue = revenue_2024['Amount in USD'].sum()

print(f'Total Revenue for 2024: \${total_revenue:,.2f}')

# Show breakdown by FSLine Statement L2 for verification
print('\n=== Revenue Breakdown by L2 Category ===')
breakdown = revenue_2024.groupby('FSLine Statement L2')['Amount in USD'].sum()
print(breakdown)
print(f'\nTotal: \${breakdown.sum():,.2f}')
"
